## Trump struggles boost Democrats

Trump's slide in the polls in recent weeks could signify good news for Democrats ahead of November's midterm elections. In the newest Economist/YouGov poll, Democrats hold an 8-point lead over the GOP in a generic congressional ballot. [...] Aside from Trump's continued struggles with his approval rating, a majority of respondents in the newest poll also said they believed the president is using his presidential powers for his own benefit.
